evidence.api_auth_boundary: Unauthenticated /api/bootstrap returns 401 in repeated live proofs.
evidence.runtime_health: Repeated /api/health checks returned 200; no 5xx condition was observed in the sampled proof window.
evidence.claim_boundary: Crawler discovery is proven; search-engine indexing, credential exposure and protected-data disclosure are not claimed.

root_cause: The dedicated customer-proof host is intentionally public for outside-in proof, but the exposed staging surface has no verified crawler exclusion endpoint at /robots.txt. Authentication protects application data, yet public discovery of a staging host is broader exposure than required for proof and should be explicitly controlled.
containment: Keep fixture_only=true, staging_only=true, pilot_ready=false and production_approved=false.
Do not weaken the existing authentication or tenant-isolation boundary to simplify crawler handling.
Do not mutate the sealed runtime artifact solely to add crawler controls.
Treat public staging discovery as exposure telemetry and preserve request evidence.
Do not place customer or production secrets/data on this public proof host.

detection_rules.when: A customer-proof or staging host has a public internet domain.
require: GET /robots.txt returns 200 with a deny-all policy unless explicit indexing has been approved.
Public HTML responses carry an independently verified noindex control such as X-Robots-Tag or equivalent where supported.
Unauthenticated protected APIs continue to fail closed.
Crawler-control changes do not alter the sealed business runtime or tenant boundary without full candidate revalidation.

safe_runbook: First prefer a reversible staging-edge or deployment-wrapper control that does not modify the sealed business runtime.
Re-run public health, unauthenticated bootstrap, authenticated journey, tenant-isolation and crawler-policy probes on the exact candidate.
If the platform cannot provide an edge-level crawler control, design a bounded wrapper change and require the full security/integrity/customer-proof gates before staging promotion.
Never use robots policy as an access-control mechanism; authentication and authorization remain mandatory.
learning: A public proof endpoint can be healthy and correctly authenticated while still creating unnecessary discovery exposure. Availability evidence and exposure minimisation are separate gates.
